messages:
mia: Quick all-hands follow-up for AEs/SEs re: trials, partners, and Dedicated guidance.
mia: Top asks: 1) mark inbound trials as POC vs Opportunity? 2) partner co-sell pilot terms? 3) Where to point AEs for Hosted->Dedicated guidance and migration notes.
owen: Rule: inbound trials = POC until a signed PO or active subscription. POCs should not be in commit; put expected close in POC field.
owen: Partner pilot: registered partners only, 10% co-sell credit for Q2 pilot, credits applied at invoice, no retro credits. Registration via the partners form in #partners.
paul: Sales Ops will publish a one-tab calc for co-sell credits and add it to the quote template. Eng Infra will supply GPU sizing inputs for Dedicated quotes.
trina: Product will publish a one-pager decision tree (signals -> recommended deployment) and a short AE pitch. SEs: well publish a migration stub with lead times and terraform snippet.
partner-ops-bot: Partner form -> https://redwood.co/partners/register
mia: Recap action items: 1) Paul/Sales Ops: calc + template; 2) Trina/Product: one-pager + pitch; 3) Partner Ops: office hours & registration tracking. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
owen: :white_check_mark: will share calc.
trina: :white_check_mark: one-pager draft up.
paul: :white_check_mark: quote template updated.
mia: Thanks all  closing thread.
